机制概述: Magdelina gains Trance Counters over time. She can spend Trance to Level Up, growing permanently more powerful.

效果.效果: Activate Level 0. Your other Levels are inactive. Deplete all Trance.
Level Up: Level Up by activating the next Level in sequence (0 > 1 > 2 > 3 > 4 > 5). Only one Level can be active at a time. Deactivate any older Level when activating a new one.
